known.via: English Wikipedia "Western Australia (wine)" (redirects to "Western Australian wine")

climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: Australia's largest state, with wine regions almost entirely in the cooler south-western tip. It makes less than 5% of the country's wine but wins 30 percent of its medals.
